headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw for 270 yards and two touchdowns to end his home struggles and the Tennessee Titans had their highest point total of the season in a 36-22 victory over the Jacksonville Jagua
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans end home woes, roll to 36-22 victory over Jaguars

headlines.description: The Washington Redskins and Cincinnati Bengals played a 27-27 tie Sunday in London as the NFL got its second tied game in a season for the first time since 1997.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins, Bengals battle to 27-27 tie in London

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Patriots quarterback Tom Brady asserted his on-field ownership of the Buffalo Bills again Sunday, matching an NFL record in beating them for the 26th time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws 4 TDs in Patriots 41-25 win over Buffalo Bills

events.name: New York Jets at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Matt Forte ran for 82 yards and a pair of second-half touchdowns, helping the New York Jets rally past the still winless Cleveland Browns 31-28 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets rally past still winless Browns 31-28

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw two touchdown passes in relief of the injured Alex Smith to help the Kansas City Chiefs hold off Indianapolis 30-14 on Sunday.

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 265 yards and a touchdown, scored on a quarterback keeper, and the New Orleans Saints overcame several big plays by Seattle to defeat the Seahawks 25-20 on Sunday.

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a 41-yard touchdown pass to Seth Roberts with 1:45 remaining in overtime, capping a record-breaking day for the Oakland Raiders in a 30-24 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers o
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws for 4 TDs, Raiders outlast Bucs 30-24 in OT

headlines.description: Jonathan Stewart ran for 95 yards and two touchdowns, Thomas Davis returned a fumble 46 yards for a score and the Carolina Panthers snapped a four-game losing streak with a 30-20 victory over the
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers snap 4-game losing streak, top Cardinals 30-20

headlines.description: Brock Osweiler bounced back from an ugly performance by throwing for 186 yards and a touchdown to help the Houston Texans remain perfect at home this season with a 20-13 win over the Detroit Lion
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans remain perfect at home with 20-13 win over Lions

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: The Denver Broncos took turns picking off and pummeling Philip Rivers in a 27-19 win over the San Diego Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos pick apart Rivers in 27-19 win over Chargers

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw an 11-yard touchdown pass to Mohamed Sanu with 31 seconds remaining, rallying the Atlanta Falcons to a 33-32 victory over Aaron Rodgers and the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons rally to beat Packers 33-32 on Sanu's TD catch

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw a 5-yard touchdown pass to Jason Witten in overtime, giving the Dallas Cowboys their sixth straight win with a 29-23 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott rallies Cowboys to OT win over Eagles 29-23

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw for 252 yards and a touchdown after missing five games, rookie Jordan Howard ran for a career-high 153 yards and a TD, and the Chicago Bears stunned the Minnesota Vikings 20-10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler, Howard lead Bears to 20-10 win over Vikings
